content:
Here's something that always cracks me up about anime:

The fact that characters can have the most dramatic, tear-jerking backstory explaining their tragic past... and then their special power is something like "I can turn into a rubber duck" or "My hair becomes incredibly shiny when I'm emotional."

Also, the classic anime logic where a character can survive being launched through 17 buildings by a villain's ultimate attack, but trips over a small pebble and needs to be hospitalized for three episodes! 😄

And don't get me started on how anime characters can have entire philosophical debates and flashback montages in the 2.5 seconds they're falling off a cliff. Time works very differently in anime land!

What's your favorite silly anime trope?
